en.tagline: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via belt CLI
en.summary: This skill runs AI image models through the inference.sh belt CLI. It covers text-to-image, image editing, inpainting, LoRA styles, upscaling and text rendering, using models such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream and Reve. You choose a model by its app ID and pass a JSON input.
problem: Image generation tools differ in model names, input fields and features such as editing, LoRA support or text rendering. Choosing one and getting its input format right takes time.
With this skill, the agent runs a single `belt app run` command with a model app ID and a JSON prompt. It can also send an image URL for edits, or run an upscaler on a result.
fit: Generating product photos or mockups from a text prompt
Editing an existing image with a text instruction, such as changing a background
Making social media graphics or marketing visuals that need readable text
Upscaling an image with a dedicated upscaler app
unfit: Working without the belt CLI or an inference.sh setup
Tasks that need a model not in the listed apps, or local model control
steps: Pick a model from the table by its app ID, or list image apps with `belt app list --category image`.
Write a JSON input with a `prompt`, and add `images` with image URLs for editing or other model-specific fields such as `aspect_ratio`.
Run the model with `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'`.
Optionally upscale the result with `falai/topaz-image-upscaler` or combine images with `infsh/stitch-images`.

zh.tagline: 通过 belt CLI 调用50多种模型生成和编辑图片
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 调用 AI 图像模型。它支持文生图、图片编辑、局部重绘、LoRA 风格、放大和文字渲染，可用的模型包括 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream 和 Reve。你用应用 ID 选择模型，并传入 JSON 输入。
problem: 不同图像生成工具的模型名称、输入字段和功能（如编辑、LoRA 支持、文字渲染）各不相同。选定一个模型并写对输入格式需要花时间。
使用这个技能后，智能体只需运行一条 `belt app run` 命令，附上模型应用 ID 和 JSON 提示词。编辑时还可以传入图片链接，也可以对生成结果做放大。
fit: 根据文字提示生成产品照片或样机
用文字指令编辑已有图片，例如更换背景
制作需要清晰文字的社交媒体图或营销视觉图
用专门的放大应用提升图片分辨率
unfit: 无法使用 belt CLI 或没有 inference.sh 环境
需要表中未列出的模型，或需要自行控制本地模型
steps: 先用 `belt login` 登录一次。
从表格中按应用 ID 选择模型，或用 `belt app list --category image` 列出图像应用。
编写 JSON 输入，包含 `prompt`；编辑时加入 `images` 图片链接，并按需加入 `aspect_ratio` 等模型专用字段。
用 `belt app run <应用ID> --input '<json>'` 运行模型。
可选：用 `falai/topaz-image-upscaler` 放大结果，或用 `infsh/stitch-images` 拼接多张图片。
